subject: CS477
filterSummary: Selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering key topics in compiler design theory. The English selections heavily feature Neso Academy and other high-reach channels for their proven quality and clarity. The Arabic selections are the most popular and relevant videos available for each topic, with channels like Abdulwahab Alhendi and مبادرة زاد providing strong content. All selections passed strict relevance, quality, and metadata gates.

videos.title: Conversion of NFA to DFA
videos.filter_reason: This is the most-viewed and highly-rated tutorial on the topic from a very reputable educational channel, providing a clear and comprehensive explanation of NFA to DFA conversion.
